title: Sending to a LOCAL session by its host-qualified address creates a new mailbox and does not wake (durableButNotWoken)
outcome: A send to a local session by its host-qualified address (the central host's own host id) resolves to the same local session and the same existing pair mailbox, and wakes it exactly like a plain local session-id send.
acceptance: The cause is identified in source: why a self-host-qualified address is treated as a different participant or mailbox and why the wake is not delivered.

A minimal fix reusing the existing address resolution makes self-host-qualified sends resolve to the same local session and existing pair mailbox and wake normally, with one deterministic test and a clean review pair.
